DIRECTION A — Refined

Same palette, same blue. Fixes what is actually weak: a real type ramp (23/15/14/10.5 instead of everything at 13px), a compact player so Ask owns the rail, and cards whose art carries the speaker palette.

Tradeoff: safe. Reads as a competent product, not a memorable one.

DIRECTION B — Editorial

Instrument Serif headlines, warmer near-black, amber accent. Transcript becomes the reading column; the summary steps back. The library reads as an index, not a card grid.

Tradeoff: further from real Fathom, and the serif is a commitment. Stronger character, more risk.
Both use the real seeded content and the existing 8-colour speaker palette. Neither changes information architecture — only hierarchy, density and type.
